NONE: › relaxed and not worrying about things that you cannot change
放鬆的；（對無法改變的事情）不擔心的

› a form of Buddhism, originally developed in Japan, that emphasizes that religious knowledge is achieved through emptying the mind of thoughts and giving attention to only one thing, rather than by reading religious writings
禪，禪宗（佛教派別之一，強調禪定而止息雜慮）

example: Don't worry about doing the right thing with your baby - be more zen about it and you'll be happier.
不要擔心為自己的孩子你是否採取了正確的行動——越放鬆你就會越高興。

NONE: › the best or most successful point or time

example: In the 1860s, Tolstoy was at the zenith of his achievement.
1860年代，托爾斯泰處於創作巔峰時期。
